card.title: Director, Global Supply Chain Center of Excellence – Chemical Manufacturing
card.description:
**The Opportunity:**
--------------------

**Position purpose**

 
 

Lead the global Supply Chain Center of Excellence across three pillars: Planning Excellence & Governance; Analytics, Optimization & Value Improvement; and Data, Systems & Digital Enablement.

 
 

Strengthen supply chain performance by establishing consistent planning practices, delivering actionable analysis and measurable improvements, and enabling reliable data and effective planning technology. Partner with regional supply chain leaders to build capabilities and sustain improvements while regional teams retain operational supply and inventory accountability.

 
 

**How you will thrive and create an impact**

 

**Planning Excellence & Governance**

* Establish global planning standards, business rules, decision rights, and exception thresholds.
* Define planning horizons, freeze rules, and handoffs between master supply planning, site scheduling, materials planning, and regional supply planning.
* Own S&OE/S&OP process design, calendars, review standards, and escalation methods.
* Establish Plan for Every Part (PFEP) standards and review methods for finished goods, raw materials, and packaging.
* Assess planning-process adoption and effectiveness, identify gaps, and lead improvements with regional owners.
* Build planner capabilities through training, coaching, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.

**Analytics, Optimization & Value Improvement**

* Establish common KPIs, dashboards, and performance-analysis methods across regions.
* Lead capacity scenarios and inventory modeling to support supply, working-capital, and investment decisions.
* Develop inventory policies, safety-stock methods, and replenishment recommendations with regional teams.
* Partner with Manufacturing and regional planning teams to improve capacity utilization, campaign planning, and planning parameters.
* Identify and quantify value leakage, including excess inventory, expiry, write-offs, premium freight, and avoidable expediting.
* Develop prioritized improvement initiatives with clear business cases, accountable execution owners, and milestones.
* Track corrective actions and validate realized benefits with Finance, distinguishing recurring savings, cash release, and cost avoidance.

**Data, Systems & Digital Enablement**

* Establish master-data standards, business ownership, validation controls, and data-quality remediation processes.
* Prioritize SAP planning gaps and configuration issues and lead business resolution with IT.
* Lead the business workstream for planning system implementation and SAP integration, including requirements, data readiness, testing, and deployment readiness.
* Advance reporting and workflow automation to improve planning productivity and exception management.
* Develop AI-enabled reporting, exception insights, and commentary with appropriate validation and accountable business review.
* Lead planner training, system adoption, and post-implementation improvement.
* Maintain a technology roadmap aligned with planning needs and measurable business outcomes.

**Leadership and cross-functional alignment**

* Set a balanced CoE roadmap across the three pillars, prioritizing resources against business needs.
* Lead and develop the CoE team with clear responsibilities and performance expectations.
* Partner with regional supply chain leaders, Manufacturing, Sourcing, Quality, Finance, and IT to implement improvements.
* Communicate progress, risks, benefits, and decisions required to supply chain leadership.
 

 

**Measures of success**

 
 

**Planning excellence**

* Adoption and effectiveness of planning standards, PFEP reviews, and S&OE/S&OP processes.
* Improved planning discipline, handoffs, and planner capability.

**Analytics and improvement**

* Quality and use of analysis in business decisions.
* Inventory and capacity improvements delivered with regional teams.
* Reduction in value leakage and Finance-validated benefits.

**Data and digital enablement**

* Planning-data accuracy and closure of critical data issues.
* Delivery and adoption of SAP, Netstock, and automation improvements.
* Measurable improvements in planning productivity and decision support.
 

 

**What we're looking for**

 
 

**Required**

* Typically 10 or more years of progressive supply chain experience, including team leadership and cross-functional improvement.
* Strong knowledge of master planning, capacity planning, inventory management, PFEP, and S&OE/S&OP.
* Demonstrated experience establishing planning governance and delivering measurable operational improvements.
* Proven leadership of teams and large, complex transformation programs across multiple sites or regions.
* Strong track record leading planning-system implementations, organizational change, training, and sustained adoption.
* Deep SAP planning expertise, including master-data governance and configuration, sufficient to guide business design and challenge technical solutions.
* Strong analytical judgment, with experience directing BI reporting, dashboards, and optimization initiatives to improve business performance.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, establish planning governance, and deliver measurable operational and financial results.

 

**Preferred**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Chemicals or batch/process manufacturing experience.
* Experience leading a global-scale CoE or planning transformation.
* SAP and Netstock or comparable planning-platform experience.
* ASCM/APICS certification, Lean Six Sigma qualification, or an advanced degree.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this position. Avantor is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

**Why Avantor?**

**Dare to go further in your career.** Join our global team of 14,000+ associates whose passion for discovery and determination to overcome challenges relentlessly advances life-changing science.
 
 
**The work we do changes people's lives for the better.** It brings new patient treatments and therapies to market, giving a cancer survivor the chance to walk his daughter down the aisle. It enables medical devices that help a little boy hear his mom's voice for the first time. Outcomes such as these create unlimited opportunities for you to contribute your talents, learn new skills and grow your career at Avantor.
 
 
We are committed to helping you on this journey through our diverse, equitable and inclusive culture which includes learning experiences to support your career growth and success. At Avantor, dare to go further and see how the impact of your contributions set science in motion to create a better world. **Apply today!**

For more information about equal employment opportunity protections, please view the Know Your Rights poster.

card.title: Director of Process Engineering & Continuous Improvement
card.description:
The Director of Process Engineering & Continuous Improvement is the company's technical authority for how meals are made and the owner of its improvement engine. This hands-on leader combines deep manufacturing process engineering with a disciplined continuous improvement approach to make production operations more consistent, efficient, safe, and cost-effective across Mom's Meals.

The role will focus primarily on kitchen and production operations, supporting a highly automated manufacturing environment through process design, equipment performance, root cause problem solving, and structured improvement projects. The position will also support fulfillment operations by identifying automation and process opportunities that improve throughput, labor efficiency, accuracy, and customer service.

The Director partners closely with Production, Fulfillment, Supply Chain, Food Safety and Quality, Maintenance, R&D, IT, and Finance to execute strategic projects and deliver measurable, sustained improvement across the enterprise. This is a player-coach role: the Director is expected to engage directly on the production floor, lead technical problem solving, and develop the engineers and improvement practitioners on the team.

***This position will travel to our other facilities 25-50% at varying times.***

***Ideally, the selected candidate will work out of one of our Production facilities (Ankeny/Grinnell, IA, Oklahoma City, OK, or North Jackson, OH) but are open to remote for the right skills and experience.***

Benefits

Our employees enjoy a generous package of benefits that we are thrilled to provide, and feel is part of what makes us different as an employer. We value our team members, and this is one way we can show it.

Benefits include:

* PTO, holiday pay and holiday of choice

* 401(k) match

* Life insurance

* Short-term disability

* Health, dental and vision insurance

* Maternity/paternity leave

* Health savings account (HSA)

* Flex spending accounts (FSA) – health and dependent

### **Position Responsibilities may include, but not limited to**

Process & Technical Engineering

* Serve as the company's process authority for meal production, owning process design, line layouts, standard work, and process specifications for cooking, chilling, portioning, and packaging
* Lead structured process control plans, risk assessments, and capability studies to reduce variation and improve consistency
* Drive yield, discard, and portion-control improvements through engineering-based solutions
* Partner with Production, Food Safety and Quality, Maintenance and R&D teams to ensure process changes are validated, documented, and sustained on the production floor
* Reduce downtime and defects through root cause analysis and hands-on, engineering-based problem solving
* Evaluate emerging manufacturing technologies and process innovations that improve efficiency, quality, and scalability
* Ensure engineering and process solutions comply with USDA, FDA, food safety, sanitary design, and regulatory requirements

Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence

* Build and lead a multi-site continuous improvement program, maintaining a prioritized project portfolio with defined savings targets validated with Finance
* Champion Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and structured problem-solving methodologies (such as A3, DMAIC, value stream mapping, changeover reduction, and standard work)
* Drive waste reduction, productivity improvement, and labor optimization initiatives
* Evaluate operational KPIs, including OEE, yield, labor productivity, and discards, and use data analytics to prioritize improvement opportunities
* Coach kitchen and production leaders and engineers in structured problem solving, and ensure improvements are standardized and sustained
* Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement across operations

Kitchen & Production Engineering

* Lead engineering efforts supporting highly automated meal production operations
* Drive equipment performance, uptime, and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) improvements
* Identify ideal equipment required to produce Mom's Meals to specification at scale, including equipment that should be replaced or decommissioned and equipment that can deliver OEE improvements and a measurable return on investment
* Partner with Production leadership and Commercialization team to identify bottlenecks and improve throughput
* Lead facility expansion projects, line installations, equipment upgrades, and process redesign initiatives

Capital & Automation Projects

* Develop and manage the engineering capital plan, prioritizing projects by safety, quality, and measurable return
* Lead project prioritization, design, budgeting, vendor selection, implementation, and startup activities
* Ensure projects are completed safely, on time, and within budget
* Manage external engineering firms, contractors, equipment suppliers, and system integrators
* Build a practical, multi-year automation roadmap focused on productivity, yield, and labor efficiency
* Establish project governance, reporting, and post-implementation performance reviews

Maintenance & Reliability Partnership

* Partner with Maintenance leadership on standards for asset management, equipment lifecycle planning, and preventative, predictive, and reliability-centered maintenance practices
* Use maintenance KPIs, including downtime, PM completion rates, equipment failure rates, and maintenance costs, to prioritize engineering and improvement work

Leadership & Team Development

* Provide coaching, mentorship, and technical leadership to process engineering, continuous improvement, and engineering personnel
* Develop future engineering leaders, improvement practitioners, and technical subject matter experts
* Promote a culture focused on safety, engagement, accountability, and operational excellence

### **Required Skills and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related technical field
* 10+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience within manufacturing, food production, and highly automated operations, including leading process engineering or continuous improvement teams
* Hands-on experience applying Lean and Six Sigma tools, with a demonstrated record of delivering quantified, sustained savings and performance gains
* Strong process engineering skills, including process design, root cause analysis, process capability, statistical analysis, and OEE and yield analytics
* Demonstrated success leading capital projects and automation implementations, including equipment installations and line upgrades
* Working knowledge of industrial automation, controls, packaging systems, and manufacturing technologies
* Knowledge of Sanitary Design Principles and Standards for food manufacturing.
* Experience leading teams in regulated manufacturing environments
* Proven ability to influence cross-functional leaders and drive enterprise-wide change

### **Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification
* Food manufacturing, packaged goods, pharmaceutical, and automated distribution experience
* Experience with Industry 4.0 technologies, predictive maintenance, and digital manufacturing tools
* Experience managing and understanding facility utility controls, including HVAC, water, and steam systems
* Professional Engineer (PE) license or advanced technical degree

**Company Overview**

Mom’s Meals is a home-delivered meal service providing fully prepared, refrigerated meal solutions direct to homes nationwide since 1999. We provide seniors, patients recovering post-discharge and those managing a chronic condition with tailored nutrition solutions to manage their specific needs. If you are passionate about the well-being of others and have a strong sense of community, Mom’s Meals could be the place for you! We are a family operated business looking for fun, compassionate, and friendly people who want to make a difference in the lives of others.

 

**EEO**

Mom’s Meals complies with all applicable federal and state non-discrimination laws. Qualified applicants shall receive consideration for employment without regards to race, religion, national origin, ancestry, color, gender, age, disability, or veteran status.

card.title: Plant Manager-Northeast Water Treatment Plant
card.description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

Provides leadership and management for treatment plant operations, process control, regulatory compliance, laboratory activities, preventive and corrective maintenance coordination, safety programs, emergency preparedness, employee development, budget administration, inventory control, contractor activities, and facility improvement projects. Evaluates plant performance and treatment processes, establishes operational priorities, develops and implements procedures, and directs corrective actions necessary to maintain treatment quality, regulatory compliance, equipment reliability, and continuity of operations.

**Essential Functions**
-----------------------

• Recognizes and fulfills the professional and ethical obligations associated with an FDEP treatment operator license. Ensures licensed duties and treatment operations are performed in accordance with FDEP requirements, applicable federal, state, and local laws and standards, permit conditions, County policies, established operating procedures, and safety requirements. Exercises professional judgment in a manner that protects public health, employee safety, water quality, environmental quality, and the integrity of the County's treatment operations.
 
• Plans, directs, manages, and evaluates the operations and activities of an assigned water or wastewater treatment facility to ensure safe, reliable, efficient, and regulatory-compliant operations. Establishes facility priorities, coordinates personnel and resources, evaluates operational performance, and provides overall management and technical direction for treatment processes, maintenance activities, laboratory functions, safety programs, regulatory compliance, and facility support activities.
 
• Supervises, directs, develops, and evaluates assigned employees; coordinates daily work activities; organizes, prioritizes, and assigns work; monitors work in progress and completed work; addresses employee concerns and performance matters; provides coaching, counseling, training, and technical expertise; completes employee performance evaluations; and administers personnel responsibilities consistent with County policies and delegated authority.
 
• Directs and evaluates water treatment processes and equipment applicable to the assigned facility, including pumping, chemical treatment and disinfection, filtration, membrane and reverse osmosis systems, biological treatment, aeration, clarification, sludge and solids handling, storage, wells, and related treatment equipment. Ensures treatment processes are operated and adjusted as necessary to maintain treatment performance, water quality, regulatory compliance, equipment reliability, and continuity of operations.
 
• Evaluates plant performance through SCADA systems, computerized controls, laboratory and process-control results, instrumentation, gauges, meters, alarms, flow conditions, chemical feed rates, equipment performance, treatment loading, and operational trends. ***Job Code: 48086***

***Job Location:*** ***Camden, AR***

***Job Schedule:*** ***4/10: Employees work 10 hours per day, 4 days a week***

**Job Description:**

L3Harris Technologies is seeking an experienced **Senior Quality Manager** to lead quality assurance operations and drive excellence across our defense programs. This strategic leadership role is responsible for ensuring the highest standards of quality, compliance, and customer satisfaction while managing quality teams and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. The Senior Quality Manager will serve as a key liaison between customers, regulatory agencies, and internal stakeholders to maintain L3Harris's reputation for delivering mission-critical solutions that meet the most stringent quality requirements.

The **Senior Quality Manager** provides executive-level oversight of quality management systems, processes, and personnel across assigned business units or programs. This role requires a seasoned quality professional who can balance strategic planning with hands-on problem-solving in a fast-paced aerospace and defense environment.

In this capacity, you will direct all aspects of quality assurance including manufacturing quality, inspection operations, and quality engineering. You will be accountable for maintaining AS9100 and ISO 9001 certifications, ensuring compliance with FAA and DoD regulations, and meeting contractual quality requirements for complex defense systems and aerospace products.

The ideal candidate will demonstrate proven expertise in leading cross-functional teams, managing customer quality relationships, and implementing data-driven quality improvement initiatives. You will work closely with Program Management, Engineering, Operations, and Supply Chain leadership to embed quality throughout the product lifecycle—from design and development through production, delivery, and field support.

This position demands strong technical knowledge of aerospace/defense manufacturing processes, exceptional leadership skills, and the ability to influence at all organizational levels.

The ideal candidate will drive cultural change, mentor quality professionals, and establish L3Harris as a quality leader in the defense industry.

**Essential Functions:**

* Quality Leadership & Management
* Quality System Development & Compliance
* Product Quality & Inspection Operations
* Nonconformance Management & Problem Resolution
* Risk Management & Process Improvement
* Customer & Stakeholder Interface
* Documentation & Records Management
* Quality Cost Management

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree with a minimum of 12 years prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree with a minimum of 10 years prior relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 16 years of prior relevant experience.

* Demonstrated experience managing quality operations.
* Proven track record leading Material Review Board (MRB) activities and nonconformance resolution.
* Hands-on experience with AS9100, ISO 9001, and other aerospace quality management system standards.
* Background in document control systems and configuration management practices.
* Experience interfacing with government customers (DoD, NASA, FAA) and managing customer quality requirements.
* Knowledge of inspection methods, precision measurement, and calibration systems for aerospace components.
* Experience with quality cost management and budget administration

**JOB SUMMARY**

Responsible for communicating the concept of Total Quality Management through advising, coaching, training, and facilitating. Position works with direct reports, General Managers, and other staff to develop and implement quality assurance strategies. The position is responsible for ensuring that quality processes meet company’s mission and brand standards, target customer needs, ensure employee satisfaction, and focus on continuous improvement at the property level. .

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

**Education and Experience**

* 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 4 years experience in the guest services, front desk, housekeeping, sales and marketing, management operations, or related professional area.

OR

* 4-year bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, housekeeping, sales and marketing, management operations, or related professional area.

**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**

**Managing Quality Assurance Goals**

* Coaches managers on adopting the Total Quality Management leadership style.

* Makes and executes the necessary decisions to keep property moving forward toward achievement of goals.

* Directs property quality efforts to address critical customer requirements.

* Facilitates process improvement teams, assuring use of the systematic processes, and improvement is achievable and measurable.

**Leading Quality Assurance Team**

* Trains team members and managers on problem solving, process improvement and strategic planning techniques

* Develops systems to enable employees to understand guest satisfaction results.

* Communicates a clear and consistent message regarding departmental goals to produce desired results.

* Coaches managers on adopting the Total Quality Management leadership style.

* Educates new employees on the foundations of the quality processes, how to use quality tools and their role in continuous improvement.

* Familiarizes employees with the daily quality production reports and how to spot trends in their work areas and initiate root cause analysis.

**Managing Quality Tools**

* Ensures that management practices at all levels are aligned with quality tools.

* Uses data collection methods to compile, display, track, and analyze defect trends.

* Demonstrates and communicates key drivers of guest satisfaction for the brand’s target customer.

* Analyzes issues and identifies trends.

**Managing the Guest Experience**

* Reviews guest feedback with leadership team and ensures appropriate corrective action is taken.

* Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.

* Stays visible and interfaces with customers on a regular basis to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.

* Creates an atmosphere in all properties that meets or exceeds guest expectations.

**Managing and Conducting Human Resources Activities**

* Facilitates the development of creative solutions to overcome obstacles and ensures implementation to continually improve guest satisfaction results.

* Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.

* Ensures that regular, ongoing communication is happening in quality assurance.

* Fosters employee commitment to providing excellent service, participates in daily stand-up meetings and models desired service behaviors in all interactions with guests and employees.

* Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of staff/operations meetings with an emphasis on generating innovative ways to continually improve results.

* Sets goals and expectations for direct reports using the performance review process and holds staff accountable for successful performance.

* Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an “open door policy” and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.

* Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and supports the Peer Review Process.

* Conducts annual performance appraisal with direct reports according to Standard Operating Procedures.

* Champions change, ensures brand and regional business initiatives are implemented and communicates follow-up actions to team as necessary.

*At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.*

card.title: Senior Manager Infrastructure Engineering and Operations
card.description:
Changing lives. Building Careers.

Joining us is a chance to do important work that creates change and shapes the future of healthcare. Thinking differently is what we do best. To us, change equals opportunity. Every day, our colleagues are challenging what’s possible and making headway to innovate new treatment pathways to advance patient outcomes and set new standards of care.

The Senior Manager, Infrastructure Engineering & Operations leads enterprise infrastructure engineering, platform operations, service delivery, modernization, resilience, and operational process maturity. The role is accountable for reliable, secure, scalable, compliant, and supportable infrastructure services that enable Integra’s business and manufacturing operations.

This position leads infrastructure employees and service providers, establishes platform ownership and operating standards, drives infrastructure projects and modernization initiatives, and partners across Digital Technology, Cybersecurity, Quality, Manufacturing, and business functions to improve service performance, risk management, recovery capabilities, and execution.

### **Key Responsibilities**

Infrastructure Leadership and Platform Ownership

* Lead enterprise infrastructure engineering and operations within a globally aligned operating model.
* Establish ownership, standards, lifecycle requirements, support models, and accountability for compute, cloud, network, identity, storage, backup, recovery, virtualization, monitoring, and automation platforms.
* Ensure infrastructure services are reliable, resilient, secure, scalable, compliant, supportable, and operationally stable.
* Serve as the senior infrastructure subject matter expert and provide guidance on architecture, engineering, operations, reliability, and platform risk.

Service Delivery and Operational Excellence

* Lead incident, problem, change, performance, capacity, and reliability management for infrastructure services.
* Establish service levels, operational metrics, escalation paths, root-cause practices, and sustainable improvement plans.
* Partner with the Service Desk, End User Computing, application teams, and business stakeholders to improve end-to-end service delivery and clarify ownership.
* Promote disciplined operations, documentation, knowledge management, preventive maintenance, and continuous improvement.

Engineering Modernization and Transformation

* Develop and execute infrastructure roadmaps aligned with enterprise architecture, business priorities, cybersecurity requirements, and technology lifecycle needs.
* Lead cloud optimization, platform standardization, automation, infrastructure-as-code, technical-debt reduction, and engineering-led modernization.
* Simplify fragmented or manual processes and establish repeatable practices for intake, prioritization, design, delivery, change, operational transition, and escalation.
* Evaluate technologies and recommend adoption, investment, optimization, standardization, or retirement based on business value, risk, cost, and supportability.

Project and Program Delivery

* Lead infrastructure projects and programs from planning through implementation, stabilization, and transition to operational ownership.
* Establish delivery discipline for scope, milestones, resources, dependencies, risks, decisions, budgets, communications, and measurable outcomes.
* Maintain visibility into infrastructure demand and capacity and provide transparent recommendations for prioritization and sequencing.
* Ensure projects address architecture, security, quality, validation, support, monitoring, documentation, training, and lifecycle requirements, as applicable.

Cross-Functional Leadership

* Connect Infrastructure, Enterprise Architecture, Applications, End User Computing, Service Management, Cybersecurity, Quality, Manufacturing, Procurement, Finance, and business stakeholders to improve planning and execution.
* Clarify roles, responsibilities, handoffs, decision rights, dependencies, and escalation paths across services and projects.
* Facilitate decisions and resolve cross-functional barriers affecting service ownership, project delivery, risk reduction, and operational performance.
* Translate business needs, technology constraints, risks, dependencies, and investment requirements into clear priorities and executable plans.

Cybersecurity Partnership and Operational Accountability

* Partner with Cybersecurity to translate security requirements into infrastructure standards, remediation plans, operational practices, and supporting evidence.
* Maintain clear operational accountability for implementing and operating infrastructure security controls.
* Ensure timely execution of secure configuration, vulnerability remediation, logging, monitoring, identity, recovery, and resilience requirements.
* Provide infrastructure leadership during cybersecurity incidents, including containment, remediation, recovery, evidence preservation, and corrective actions.

Resilience, Recovery, and Lifecycle Risk

* Lead infrastructure backup, recovery, disaster recovery, and technology resilience activities.
* Ensure recovery services and plans are monitored, tested, improved, and aligned with established recovery objectives.
* Identify and manage lifecycle risks, technical debt, capacity constraints, recoverability gaps, and recurring service issues.
* Coordinate corrective actions with Business Continuity, Applications, Cybersecurity, Quality, and business stakeholders.

People, Vendor, and Financial Leadership

* Lead, coach, and develop infrastructure engineering and operations employees through clear goals, accountability, feedback, and development plans.
* Build team capability in cloud technologies, automation, engineering practices, service management, cybersecurity partnership, and resilience.
* Manage vendors, consultants, contractors, and service providers, establishing accountability for service performance, deliverables, costs, and issue resolution.
* Participate in budget planning, forecasting, sourcing, contracting, licensing, resource planning, and investment prioritization.
* Demonstrate Integra’s Purpose, Vision, and Values in daily work and interactions.

### **Required Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Ten or more years of progressive experience with a bachelor’s degree, or eight or more years with a master’s degree, in infrastructure engineering, infrastructure operations, cloud services, enterprise technology, or a related field.
* Five or more years of experience leading infrastructure teams, technical professionals, service providers, or complex enterprise infrastructure programs.
* Demonstrated success leading infrastructure transformation, modernization, service improvement, or operating-model maturity initiatives.
* Experience managing enterprise compute, network, identity, storage, backup, recovery, cloud, virtualization, monitoring, and automation capabilities.
* Demonstrated ownership of complex infrastructure projects or programs, including scope, resources, dependencies, risk, budget, communications, and operational transition.
* Experience establishing platform ownership, service expectations, metrics, escalation practices, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement.
* Experience managing vendors or managed service providers and holding partners accountable for delivery and service performance.
* Experience leading in a global, matrixed, and regulated environment and influencing teams outside the direct reporting line.
* Experience partnering with Cybersecurity on infrastructure remediation, controls, incident response, recovery, and resilience.

### **Skills and Competencies**

* Strong infrastructure engineering and operational leadership across enterprise platforms and services.
* Ability to lead operational delivery and transformation simultaneously while balancing reliability, risk, cost, capacity, and business priorities.
* Strong planning, prioritization, problem-solving, decision-making, stakeholder-management, coaching, and project-delivery skills.
* Ability to translate complex infrastructure issues and investment requirements into clear business language and actionable plans.

**Position Overview**

The Vice President of Operations & Supply Chain serves as an executive operational leader responsible for driving domestic manufacturing performance while scaling global strategic sourcing. Headquartered on-site at our metal fabrication and assembly facility, this role oversees domestic plant operations and integrates supply chain operations within a focused portfolio of key international suppliers. This leader will balance hands-on, plant-level operational leadership with high-level international sourcing strategy to support business growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Domestic Manufacturing & Plant Operations**

· Lead all daily plant operations across metal fabrication, assembly, quality control, safety, and inventory management.

· Drive continuous improvement (Lean / Six Sigma) to optimize throughput, reduce scrap rates, and manage labor efficiency.

· Foster a high-accountability safety culture adhering to OSHA standards.

· Maintain direct, visible leadership on the shop floor to build strong relationships with operational teams.

· Establish clear key performance indicators (KPIs) for manufacturing efficiency, operational costs, equipment utilization, and schedule adherence.

· Oversee capital expenditure (CapEx) planning, facility maintenance, and automation/equipment upgrades to optimize plant capacity and throughput.

**2. Global Supply Chain, Strategic Sourcing & Post-Acquisition Integration**

· Partner with executive business leaders to architect and execute a unified global supply chain strategy leveraging domestic fabrication alongside overseas contract manufacturing partners.

· Align and execute global supply chain initiatives to support these activities, blending distinct business models (domestic fabrication vs. Asian contract manufacturing).

· Establish vendor management systems, quality standards, and logistics frameworks for international contract manufacturers.

· Develop processes to manage import/export compliance, international logistics, tariffs, and total landed cost models.

· Evaluate and optimize global supplier networks to build resilience, optimize costs, and drive margin performance.

· Establish end-to-end supply chain visibility and inventory positioning strategies across domestic warehouses and overseas vendor pipelines

**3. Industry Alignment & Custom Project Delivery**

· Align manufacturing capacity and scheduling with the fast-paced, custom-project demand cycles typical of the hospitality furnishings/fixtures market.

· Partner with Sales, Engineering, and Project Management to deliver custom fabricated assemblies on time and within budget.

**4. Executive Leadership & Culture**

· Serve as a core member of the operational leadership team, aligning operational goals with company-wide profitability and growth targets.

· Lead with a general management orientation—translating financial targets into shop-floor operational realities.

· Thrive as a key community and company leader in a small-town operational setting.

**Candidate Qualifications**

· **Experience:** 15+ years of progressive leadership in manufacturing operations and supply chain management.

· **Industry Background:** Proven background in metal fabrication, welding, stamping, and assembly—ideally serving the hospitality, commercial interiors, or custom project-based industries.

· **Global Experience:** Demonstrated experience with international sourcing, managing Asian contract manufacturers, and post-merger supply chain integration.

· **Company Size Fit:** Experience operating in mid-market environment ($50M–$150M revenue) with 200+ employees; comfortable wearing multiple hats without heavy administrative infrastructure.

· **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in operations management and/or Supply Chain Management (Master’s / MBA preferred).

**Key Attributes & Fit Factors**

· **Dual-Oriented Leadership:** Ability to walk the factory floor in work boots in the morning and lead strategic global supplier negotiations in the afternoon.

· **Cultural & Community Fit:** Comfortable living and leading in a small-town environment while maintaining a broad, global perspective.

· **Change Management:** Skilled in bridging two distinct operational cultures—domestic manufacturing and international third-party sourcing.

Pay: $76,800.00 - $92,600.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Disability insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

The Texas Workforce Commission (TWC) is seeking a Deputy Director of Strategic Operations and Transformation to support the Vocational Rehabilitation (VR) Division. Work involves developing and executing comprehensive change management strategies that align with agency goals and improve service delivery across regions. This role is responsible not only for designing change initiatives, but also for ensuring effective implementation, adoption, and long-term sustainability through structured project management, stakeholder engagement, and continuous feedback loops.

The Deputy Director leads large-scale transformation efforts by establishing priorities, developing policies and procedures, and creating performance measures to assess progress and outcomes. This position works closely with leadership, regional staff, and stakeholders to strengthen alignment, reduce operational gaps, and ensure initiatives are informed by field insight and practical application.

This position supervises the work of others and operates under minimal supervision with extensive latitude for the use of initiative and independent judgment.

TWC is not considering applications from individuals who require sponsorship for an employment visa, now or in the future, for this position. * Leads implementation of division-wide initiatives, ensuring alignment, consistency, and measurable adoption across the division.
* Establishes project governance structures, timelines, and accountability measures to support successful execution of strategic initiatives.
* Directs and evaluates program activities and business functions related to change management and transformation efforts.
* Develops and maintains feedback mechanisms (e.g., communities of practice, listening sessions, stakeholder engagement processes) to inform continuous improvement and strengthen connection between state and field operations.
* Partners with leadership to translate strategy into operational practice and sustain long-term change.
* Leads the development and use of data systems, performance metrics, and key indicators to monitor implementation, measure adoption, and drive continuous improvement.
* Identifies and mitigates risks and resistance to change through proactive communication, coaching, and stakeholder engagement.
* Develop policies, procedures, and standardized practices to support consistency and efficiency across the division.
* Oversee and/or prepares budgets related to change initiatives, ensuring appropriate use of resources and compliance with funding requirements.
* Represents the agency at business meetings, legislative sessions, conferences, and stakeholder engagements to communicate and advance strategic initiatives.
* Supervises staff, including assigning work, evaluating performance, and supporting professional development.
* Performs related work as assigned.

* Demonstrated experience leading large-scale organizational change initiatives across multiple regions or programs.

* Strong project management experience, including oversight of multiple concurrent initiatives with defined timelines, deliverables, and outcomes.

* Certification in change management or project management (e.g., CCMP, PMP, Lean) preferred.

* Change management methodologies, tools, and implementation strategies.
* Project management principles, including planning, execution, and performance monitoring.

* Translate strategic priorities into operational implementation.
* Establish measurable goals and evaluate outcomes.
* Identify problems, evaluate alternatives, and implement effective solutions.

* Analyze data and use insights to guide decision-making and continuous improvement.
* Develop and implement policies, procedures, and standardized practices.
* Plan, assign, and supervise the work of others.

* Competitive salary: $12,500.00/month

Amphenol Communications Solutions (ACS), a division of Amphenol Corporation, is a world leader in interconnect solutions for Communications, Mobile, RF, Optics, and Commercial electronics markets. Amphenol Corporation is one of the world’s largest designers and manufacturers of electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and sensor-based products and coaxial and high-speed specialty cable. ACS has an expansive global presence in research and development, manufacturing, and sales. We design and manufacture a wide range of innovative connectors as well as cable assemblies for diverse applications including server, storage, data center, mobile, RF, networking, industrial, business equipment, and automotive.

Amphenol's High Speed IO Connectors and OverPass Solutions Business Unit is a market leader in high-speed, high-bandwidth interconnect solutions used in servers, storage, networking equipment, and data center infrastructure. Our products enable reliable, low-loss data transmission in some of the world's most advanced IT and Datacom platforms, helping power the technology behind leading Tier 1 OEMs. With global design, sales, and manufacturing teams, we are growing quickly and continuing to invest in our people and products. This role is a chance to make a real impact as part of a collaborative, fast-moving team within Amphenol's decentralized culture, where ideas are heard, initiative is encouraged, and teams are empowered to make decisions with clear accountability.

**Position: Operations Director**

**Location: USA, Remote**

***Must have multi-site global and electrical manufacturingexperience***

**Key Responsibilities**

**Operations Leadership**

* Lead new product introductions from concept to full-scale production
* Oversee global plant operations and standardize processes
* Ensure effective resource allocation and EHS best practices
* Manage critical operational issues and crisis response

**Strategy & Capacity**

* Develop and execute 3-year operational and capacity plans
* Lead expansion initiatives, new site development, and capital projects
* Forecast demand and optimize global resource utilization

**Financial Management**

* Oversee global budgets and P&L performance
* Drive cost reduction and operational efficiency
* Identify risks and implement mitigation strategies

**Performance & Reporting**

* Define and monitor KPIs (quality, delivery, productivity)
* Use data insights to improve performance and on-time delivery
* Report results and recommendations to leadership

**Collaboration & Quality**

* Partner cross-functionally to meet customer and business needs
* Ensure compliance with ISO standards and global regulations
* Maintain strong supplier quality systems and audit readiness

**Qualifications**

* 15+ years in manufacturing management (electronics or mechanical preferred)
* Degree in Engineering or related field
* Experience building and scaling manufacturing operations
* Knowledge of ISO 9001/14001, Lean, Six Sigma, 5S
* Strong leadership, analytical, and communication skills
* Willingness to travel globally (50%+); Mandarin is an asset

Amphenol Corporation is proud of our reputation as an excellent employer. Our focus is to provide the highest level of support and responsiveness to both our employees and our customers, the world's largest technology companies. Amphenol Corporation offers the opportunity for career growth within a global organization. We believe that Amphenol Corporation is unique in that every employee, regardless of his or her position, has the ability to positively impact the business.

Amphenol is an “Equal Opportunity Employer” - Minority/Female/Disabled/Veteran/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/National Origin. For additional company information please visit our website at https://www.amphenol-cs.com/

card.title: Senior Manager - Level 1 Operations
card.description:
Pico fuels the global capital markets community by providing exceptional market data services and customized managed infrastructure solutions. As financial industry experts at the center of markets and technology, we help our clients efficiently scale their business and quickly access markets. From infrastructure to connectivity, we support our clients through the full trading lifecycle. We are a global company headquartered in New York, with offices in Chicago, London, Singapore, Hong Kong and Tokyo.

**Role Description**

Pico powers the global capital markets community with high-performance market data services and tailored managed infrastructure solutions. As financial industry experts at the intersection of markets and technology, we help clients scale efficiently and access markets quickly. From infrastructure to connectivity, we support our clients across the full trading lifecycle. Pico is headquartered in New York, with offices in Chicago, London, Dublin, Madrid, Krakow, Singapore, Hong Kong, South Korea, and Tokyo.

 

**Title:** Senior Manager, Level 1 Operations

 

**About the Role**

Pico is looking for a Senior Manager, Level 1 Operations to lead its global Level 1 technical operations function supporting financial markets infrastructure. The role combines accountability for operational performance, technical capability, people development and the quality of incident response and client communication.

Pico operates mission-critical, low-latency technology supporting banks, hedge funds, asset managers, broker-dealers and other financial market participants. The Level 1 team sits at the front line of that environment and is responsible for rapid detection, triage, communication and escalation of service-impacting issues.

This is not a traditional service desk management role.

The Senior Manager, Level 1 Operations will be accountable for developing a technically strong, customer-focused operations function capable of taking meaningful ownership of incidents from the moment they are detected or reported. Alongside operational delivery, the role will drive improvements to tooling and processes and develop talent across the team. The team is expected to conduct effective first-line diagnosis across network, connectivity, server and platform domains, establish technical direction during the early stages of an incident and engage the appropriate Level 2 or engineering teams with clear evidence and context. The successful candidate will combine people leadership, strong technical judgement, incident management and excellent client communication. They will be comfortable leading critical incidents involving senior internal stakeholders, clients, carriers and technology partners while maintaining calm, structure and urgency.

 

**Key Responsibilities**

**Operational Leadership**

* Own the day-to-day operational performance of the global Level 1 team.
* Ensure operational queues and monitoring are actively managed and that nothing falls between shifts, regions or technical teams.
* Establish and track service management performance metrics covering response and triage times, escalation quality, queue health, shift-handover quality and client communication.
* Agree targets with Operations Management, review trends across shifts and regions, and use the findings to drive corrective action.
* Drive a prioritised roadmap for Level 1 tooling improvements, working with technical teams to improve monitoring, alert quality, workflow automation and operational visibility.
* Own continuous improvement of Level 1 processes, including triage, escalation, shift handovers, runbooks and knowledge management. Use incident reviews, service data and feedback from regional leads to prioritise changes, embed adoption and verify their effectiveness.

 

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, coach and develop the Level 1 Operations Engineers, working with the regional leads in AMRS, APAC and EMEA to translate global priorities into regional delivery and maintain consistent technical, behavioural and service standards.
* Work with regional leads to translate global priorities into clear local responsibilities, delegate operational ownership and review delivery against agreed standards across shifts and regions.
* Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews and career development discussions.
* Develop future technical authorities, technical specialists and team leaders from within Level 1.

**Incident Management**

* Act as the senior point of escalation for the Level 1 team and the regional leads in AMRS, APAC and EMEA when incidents, operational risks or service issues require senior direction, cross-region coordination or decisions beyond regional authority. Take ownership of the escalation and coordinate the appropriate technical and management response.
* Lead real-time technical triage across network, platform, server and connectivity domains.
* Direct incident bridges involving clients, senior stakeholders, Network Operations, Platform Operations, engineering teams, carriers and third-party providers.
* Ensure incidents are correctly prioritised and escalated based on technical and customer impact.
* Drive improvements in MTTR, first-line diagnosis and incident quality.

 

**Client & Stakeholder Management**

* Ensure consistently high standards of client communication throughout incidents and service requests.
* Communicate confidently with senior client and internal stakeholders during high-pressure situations.
* Ensure updates are technically accurate, concise, timely and appropriate for the audience.
* Work closely with Operations Management and technical teams to ensure a consistent service narrative.
* Reinforce a customer-centric rather than ticket-centric approach throughout the team.

 

**Experience and Qualifications**

 

**Essential**

* 10+ years' experience in technical operations, infrastructure support, network operations, production support or a comparable mission-critical environment.
* Demonstrable experience managing or leading technical operations/support engineers within a 24x7 or follow the sun environment, including coordinating delivery across regions and working with regional or shift leads to maintain consistent service standards.
* Strong understanding of ITIL processes or related frameworks for incident management.
* Experience leading significant incidents and technical bridges.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting ability with the technical judgement to assess first-line diagnosis across network, connectivity, server and platform domains, challenge assumptions and recognise when specialist escalation is required.
* Experience establishing KPIs and improving operational performance.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* Confidence communicating directly with senior client and internal stakeholders.
* Demonstrable ownership mentality and ability to operate effectively under pressure.

 

**Highly Desirable**

* Experience in financial services, fintech, electronic trading or low-latency infrastructure.
* Previous experience in a telecommunications or managed service provider environment.
* Experience with monitoring and infrastructure management tooling.
* Experience with Salesforce, Jira, SolarWinds Orion, or Device42.
* ITIL certification or similar service management qualification.
* Strong networking fundamentals, particularly TCP/IP, routing, switching and BGP at a CCNA level or higher.
* Good working knowledge of Linux/Unix.

 

**Working Arrangements**

This is an office-based position with a minimum of two days office attendance per week. Occasional travel may be required, but it is not expected to be regular or frequent. The core business hours to be covered by the role are 09:00 – 18:00, Monday to Friday. The role holder will be expected to work the hours necessary to perform this role, recognizing it supports multiple jurisdictions/geographies including (but not limited to) EMEA, AMRS, and APAC. Out-of-hours escalation arrangements and availability expectations will be agreed and communicated explicitly; the team's 24/7 coverage does not imply continuous personal availability.

 

**IMPORTANT DATA PRIVACY INFORMATION:**

This position is available with Pico Services Inc. The controller of your personal data will be Pico Services Inc.

For further information on what personal data we collect, how we will process your personal data and your rights with respect to your personal data please read our Pico Job Candidate Privacy Notice, View Here.

Be a part of Pico Family

Pico is an equal opportunity employer. Pico does not discriminate on the basis of a candidate's age, race, gender, color, religion, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, or other non-merit factors. All employment decisions at Pico are based on business needs, job requirements and qualifications. If you require any assistance or accommodations to be made for the recruitment process, please inform us when you submit your online application.

card.title: Director Destination Care Operations
card.description:
**Job Summary and Responsibilities**

As our **Director of Destination Care Operations**, you will serve as the strategic leader for our high-acuity patient programs, driving operational excellence for patients traveling from across the U.S. and international markets for specialty care. You will oversee the end-to-end patient journey, ensuring a concierge-caliber experience from the initial inquiry through to post-discharge. By partnering with clinical leadership, financial stakeholders, and external partners, you will optimize workflows and grow referral volumes, positioning our facility as a premier destination for complex medical services.

Every day you will lead a high-performing team by fostering a culture of service excellence, adaptability, and continuous improvement. Your focus will be on the seamless integration of intake, registration, and financial counseling workflows, ensuring both operational efficiency and fiscal responsibility. You will conduct regular patient and family rounding to identify service gaps, implement process improvements, and provide hands-on leadership as the escalation point for complex, time-sensitive patient matters, all while maintaining rigorous data integrity and reporting standards.

To be successful in this role, you will hold a Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, or a related field, accompanied by at least 5 years of progressive leadership experience within a complex, matrixed healthcare environment. You must demonstrate a proven track record in managing destination care, specialty referral, or international patient service programs. We are looking for an adaptable leader with strong process improvement skills, the ability to influence without direct authority, and a deep commitment to delivering culturally informed, high-touch care to diverse patient populations.

* Oversees the day-to-day operational performance of the destination care program, ensuring consistent and high quality service delivery across all phases of the patient journey. Oversees referral intake and coordination workflows, ensuring timely and accurate routing, follow-up, and communication with referring providers and patients.
* Ensures patients, families, and referring partners experience seamless, concierge-caliber service from initial contact through post-discharge follow-up; conducts regular patient and family rounding to assess experience, identify service gaps and recovery opportunities, reinforce service standards, and gather patient stories that reflect the destination care experience.
* Delivers and ensures culturally informed service, communication, and care coordination across diverse domestic and international patient populations. Partners with clinical leadership and clinical advisory resources to support patient care operations and ensure the clinical needs of the destination care population are addressed. Identifies and leads process improvement and workflow optimization initiatives to advance operational efficiency, service quality, and patient satisfaction; develops and maintains operational protocols and standards that support consistent program delivery.
* Supports the development and expansion of the destination care program, including identifying opportunities to grow referral volume, expand service line access, and strengthen the program’s market position. Supports market activation and outreach efforts in collaboration with strategy partners to advance destination care program visibility and referral growth; performs other duties as assigned to support organizational objectives.

 **Job Requirements**

**Minimum**

* Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, or a related field, and
* 5 or more years of progressive leadership experience in healthcare or patient services operations, and
* Experience managing and developing teams in a complex, matrixed healthcare organization, with direct accountability for program performance outcomes, and
* Experience delivering high-touch, patient-centered services for complex or high-acuity patientpopulations,including programs such as transplant, oncology, specialty referral, or equivalent tertiary orquaternary care settings

**Licensure and Certifications**

* Certified Case Manager (CCM), or
* Lean Six Sigma Blackbelt Certification (LSSBB), or
* Project Management Professional or
* Registered Nurse: AZ (RN:AZ)

**Preferred**

* Master's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, Nursing, or a related field is strongly preferred, and
* 7 or more years of progressive leadership experience in healthcare or patient services operations, and
* Clinical background including Registered Nurse (RN) licensure or equivalent clinical operations experience, and
* Experience in a dedicated destination care, international patient services, or specialty referral program at an academic medical center or large health system, and
* Experience building or expanding programs, including policy and operational protocol development, and
* Experience preparing and delivering financial and operating performance reports and presentations for leadership, and
* Experience with referral management, patient access, financial counseling, registration, or admissions workflows.

**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, and Training**

* Strong team leadership skills with a demonstrated ability to develop,coach, and hold teams accountable. Ability to travel domestically and internationally as needed.
* Strong organizational navigation skills; able to establish credibility and build productive peer relationships quickly across clinical, operational, and financial functions, lead through influence without direct authority, and drive results across functions.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver and oversee culturally informed service and communication across diverse domestic and international patient populations.
* Proven ability to build and maintain collaborative relationships with physicians, executives, clinical leadership, referral sources, patients, and families. Knowledge of high-touch service standards and service recovery for complex, high-acuity, or high-profile patient populations.
* Strong process improvement skills; able to identify workflow gaps, design operational solutions, develop and maintain protocols and service standards, and lead change effectively.
* Ability to synthesize and analyze data from multiple sources, exercise sound judgment under ambiguity, and make well-reasoned operational decisions in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
* Strong presentation and communication skills; communicates directly, transparently, and proactively with leadership and across all levels of the organization conveying complex operational and program information clearly and credibly to diverse audiences including physicians, executives, and external partners, and surfacing issues and program status early rather than waiting to be asked.
* Maintains current knowledge of destination care, specialty referral, and healthcare operations trends; applies industry insights to inform program strategy, identify improvement opportunities, and contribute to cross-site collaboration and national destination care initiatives.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Ready to make a real difference? Join SJHMC in Phoenix AZ., a 571-bed nonprofit founded by the Sisters of Mercy over 125 years ago. We're more than a hospital; we're a global destination for life-changing care, embracing patients with humankindness.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Leaders in Specialized Care:

* Barrow Neurological Institute (BNI): A world-renowned center for groundbreaking neurological research and innovative treatments.

* Level I Trauma Center: One of Arizona's busiest ERs, providing immediate, comprehensive care for critically injured patients 24/7.

Why SJHMC?

* Culture of Excellence & Well-being: We care for our people, fostering professional and personal growth.
* Community & Collaboration: Be part of a network committed to global health and well-being.

card.title: Regional Healthcare Operations Director
card.description:
Do you enjoy creating structure, improving efficiency, and helping organizations grow without sacrificing the patient experience? **Minimally Invasive Procedure Specialists** in Highlands Ranch, CO is seeking a **full-time Regional Healthcare Operations Director** to lead operational excellence across our expanding network of locations. If you're looking for a rewarding opportunity to make a significant impact and help shape the future of a growing healthcare organization, submit your application today!

As our Regional Healthcare Operations Director, you'll earn a competitive annual salary of **$120,000 - $150,000**. We're also proud to offer a **comprehensive benefits package**, including:

* Health, dental, and vision
* Paid time off (PTO)
* An employee assistance program
* A companymatched 401(k) plan
* HSA/FSA
* Life insurance
* Uniforms
* Short-/long-term disability coverage

**THE TYPE OF REGIONAL HEALTHCARE OPERATIONS DIRECTOR WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

We're searching for someone who can meet the following qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* 7+ years of progressive operations leadership within a physician practice, ambulatory surgery center (ASC), or office-based lab (OBL)
* 3+ years of experience managing managers
* Experience leading procedural or surgical specialties such as interventional radiology, vascular, cardiology, or orthopedics
* Working knowledge of front-end revenue cycle operations, prior authorization, and payer requirements
* Proven experience developing staffing models, KPIs, and budgets
* Familiarity with HIPAA, OSHA, and outpatient survey-readiness standards

Extensive leadership experience within physician practices, ambulatory surgery centers, or office-based laboratories and a proven ability to lead leaders while driving operational excellence are preferred.

**WHAT IT'S LIKE TO BE OUR REGIONAL HEALTHCARE OPERATIONS DIRECTOR**

In this full-time role, you'll oversee daily operations across all MIPS locations, ensuring procedure days run efficiently, schedules align with patient demand, and every site delivers a seamless experience. You'll partner with clinic managers and departmental leaders to develop teams, improve workflows, maintain compliance, and drive performance. You'll also play a key role in launching new locations, standardizing best practices, managing resources, and helping the organization scale successfully while maintaining operational excellence.

**ABOUT OUR COMPANY**

Our team at Minimally Invasive Procedure Specialists comprises world-renowned vascular specialists and healthcare support staff who are passionate about making a real difference in others' lives. With over four decades of combined experience and armed with cutting-edge technology, our clinic provides precise treatment for complex vascular and chronic conditions, including pelvic venous disorders, POTS, long COVID, and fibroids.

We are a beacon of hope for our patients, and we take pride in helping to improve their quality of life. If you are passionate about providing exceptional care in a progressive, supportive atmosphere and are looking to be at the forefront of healthcare innovation, we invite you to join us!

Great organizations are built by great leaders. If you're ready to guide teams, improve performance, and help drive continued growth, this could be the perfect opportunity for you! Our initial application process is fast, simple, and mobile-friendly. Apply today!

In this role, the Director of Program Operations leads a team of Operations Program Managers (OPM) and Material Program Managers (MPM) responsible for the operational elements of program execution within Mercury's Processing Technologies business unit. This role serves as the primary conduit between the line of business and operational teams, ensuring seamless coordination across engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, and growth functions.

You will be responsible for developing and executing operational program plans for critical programs, overall ownership of operational program performance, and internal communication of customer requirements affecting operational execution.

The Director of Program Operations will support proposals by providing accurate basis of cost estimates, focusing on supply chain material costs in addition to manufacturing labor costs. This work will be performed in conjunction with factory operations, supply chain, and engineering functions. Candidates must have excellent written and oral communications skills to influence across multiple functions and communicate effectively with external partners.

* Responsible for meeting the financial objectives of the business unit, including the management of Estimate at Completion (EACs) specific to operations labor and material content.
* Oversee supply chain and manufacturing milestones to ensure compliance with contract baseline.
* Monitor program risks and opportunities, including obsolescence management, reporting, and improvement actions.

* Strong analytical skills, problem‑solving capabilities, and attention to detail.
* Experience developing and mentoring high‑performing teams.
* Excellent communication skills (written, verbal, and presentation), leadership abilities, and the ability to work in an IPT environment.

card.title: Senior Director - Operations
card.description:
**Role Summary**

The Senior Director for Operations provides strategic oversight and leadership for the operational functions that drive the efficiency and effectiveness of the Service Center and its partner districts. This role is responsible for managing and aligning key operational areas, including internal and external Business Office services, Federal and State Grant Management, Planning and Performance Management, Human Resources, Organizational Operations and Information Systems to ensure seamless, high-quality support. The Senior Director ensures that all services are delivered with operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and a focus on continuous improvement. This position requires strong organizational management, process optimization, and strategic decision-making to enhance overall performance and meet the evolving needs of the ESC and the districts served.

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in related field Master’s Degree preferred
* Minimum 3 -5 years’ experience in finance
* 3-5 years’ experience in a leadership role that includes supervising and managing staff

### **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Thorough knowledge of Texas school finance procedures.
* Demonstrated skill and understanding of federal and state grants, including grant submission, budget planning, and compliance reporting.
* Ability to supervise effectively.
* Ability to effectively plan, organize, and execute large projects/initiatives.
* Proficiency and understanding of Planning and Performance Management components.
* Ability to design, deliver, and facilitate high-quality professional development for adult audiences, both in person and virtually.
* Ability to connect with diverse audiences and understand complex and unique circumstances to support growth among individuals and across regions/districts.
* Ability to coach, model and provide feedback on performance.
* Highly organized; ability to manage multiple projects at once and meet deadlines. Attention to detail with an ability to produce high-quality work in diverse environments.
* Ability to break down complex information into comprehensive parts, ask questions, synthesize, and analyze.
* Ability to influence others to achieve outcomes, both within and outside formal management structures.
* Collaborative and results oriented.
* Demonstrates a growth mindset, desire to self-reflect, give/receive feedback and continuously improve.
* Strong sense of personal accountability; takes initiative to meet ambitious goals. Builds strong relationships without compromising outcomes.

### **Essential Functions**

* Consults with Leadership team in the formulation of department goals and objectives. Collaborates closely with Sr. Leadership team to coordinate Service Center efficiency.
* Formulates and recommends improvements in departmental services.
* Work with staff to plan, implement, and evaluate programs and services based on identified needs. Foster collegiality, facilitate team building, promote high-level performance, and build a common vision with staff, with a strong focus on collaboration with staff and clients from diverse cultural backgrounds.
* Provide leadership and services to districts in areas of assignment.
* Comply with federal and state laws, State Board of Education Rules and ESC Board Policy and procedures.
* Employ effective interpersonal skills and promote a positive caring climate.
* Evaluate employees’ effectiveness; make sound recommendations relative to personnel development, placement, transfer, retention and dismissal.
* Demonstrate behavior that is professional, ethical, responsible and serve as a role model for the region.
* Contribute to the recommendation of sound policies directed toward program improvement. Keep informed of and comply with ESC policies and procedures.
* Articulate and support the ESC’s mission and instructional philosophy.

All positions at ESC 3 are defined as security-sensitive. Security-sensitive positions are those which require employees to be entrusted with the certain types of data, whether electronic or in paper form. Those data elements, as defined by the ESC 3 Data Classification and Handling Policy may include, but not limited to:

* Sensitive Personal Information (SPI) Personally
* Identifiable Information (PII)
* Protected Health Information (PHI)
* Family Educational Records (FERPA Data)
* Federal Tax Information (FTI)

It is the employees on-going responsibility to safeguard this type of data and to report any instance of lost or stolen data.
